slides.title: The sensor is the first element in the measurement chain . It has the task of converting the physical quantity to be mea
slides.body:
The sensor is the first element in the measurement chain.
It has the task of converting the physical quantity to be measured (by measuring) into
another more easily manageable.
The transducer is a sensitive device that provides a measurable electrical signal in
response to a specific measurand.
A transducer is a sensor but a sensor is not necessarily a transducer

slides.title: Resolution : variation in the value of the measurand which causes an appreciable variation in the value of the output qu
slides.body:
Resolution: variation in the value of the measurand which causes an appreciable
variation in the value of the output quantity. If the sensor works close to zero, it is
called a threshold.
Repeatability: aptitude of the instrument to provide slightly different values of the
output quantity, when the same is applied to the input by measuring, under the same
operating conditions. It is expressed in a similar way to the calibration uncertainty.
Hysteresis: the maximum difference between the values of the output corresponding to
the same measurand, when all the values of the measuring range are considered, and
each value is reached with first increasing and then decreasing measuring.

Actuators
Device that, in an automation system, transforms an automatic command decision, processed by an electronic control board
slides.body:
processed by an electronic control board, into a physical action on the process being
regulated.
An actuator therefore allows you to act on a system in order to modify its behavior and
obtain the desired output.
More generally, the actuator can be defined as a transducer capable of transforming a
signal from a physical domain (typically of the electrical type) into an equivalent
quantity belonging to another domain (e.g., mechanical, hydraulic, thermal, etc.)
DefinitionActuator

slides.title: The relay is one of the simplest and most used actuators in the automotive field . The relay can be defined as an electr
slides.body:
actuators in the automotive field.
The relay can be defined as an electromechanical
switch that allows you to divide the control of an
element from the power part necessary for
implementation.
The relay therefore consists of two distinct circuits:
Control circuit: consists of a coil; when this coil is
crossed by electric current, it is excited
Power circuit: consists of the contacts and the
user; the contacts can be normally open or
normally closed
